title: ExperimentalResults
description: Comprehensive collection of experimental results from enzymatic reactions.

activity.title: activity
activity.description: Enzyme activity and initial reaction rate data.

kinetics.title: kinetics
kinetics.description: Kinetic parameters and enzyme behavior characteristics.

notes.title: notes
notes.description: Additional notes or comments about the experimental results.

selectivity.title: selectivity
selectivity.description: Selectivity measurements including stereoselectivity and enantioselectivity.

yield_and_conversion.title: yield_and_conversion
yield_and_conversion.description: Product yield and substrate conversion measurements.

ActivityResults.title: ActivityResults
ActivityResults.description: Enzyme activity measurements and initial reaction rate data.

initial_reaction_rate.title: initial_reaction_rate
initial_reaction_rate.description: Initial reaction rate measured at the beginning of the reaction.

specific_activity.title: specific_activity
specific_activity.description: Specific activity representing enzyme activity per unit mass of enzyme protein.

InhibitionParameters.title: InhibitionParameters
InhibitionParameters.description: Parameters describing enzyme inhibition characteristics and mechanisms.

inhibition_constant.title: inhibition_constant
inhibition_constant.description: Inhibition constant (Ki) quantifying the strength of inhibitor binding.

KineticResults.title: KineticResults
KineticResults.description: Kinetic parameters characterizing enzyme behavior and reaction mechanisms.

catalytic_efficiency.title: catalytic_efficiency
catalytic_efficiency.description: Catalytic efficiency (kcat/Km) indicating the enzyme's effectiveness at low substrate concentrations.

dissociation_constant.title: dissociation_constant
dissociation_constant.description: Dissociation constant (Kd) for enzyme-substrate or enzyme-inhibitor binding.

enzyme_stability.title: enzyme_stability
enzyme_stability.description: Qualitative or quantitative description of enzyme stability under reaction conditions.

hill_coefficient.title: hill_coefficient
hill_coefficient.description: Hill coefficient indicating cooperativity in substrate binding or enzyme kinetics.

maximum_reaction_rate.title: maximum_reaction_rate
maximum_reaction_rate.description: Maximum reaction rate (Vmax) achieved under saturating substrate conditions.

michaelis_constant.title: michaelis_constant
michaelis_constant.description: Michaelis constant (Km) representing the substrate concentration at half-maximum reaction rate.

notes.title: notes
notes.description: Additional notes about kinetic measurements or observations.

turnover_number.title: turnover_number
turnover_number.description: Turnover number (kcat) representing the maximum number of substrate molecules converted per enzyme molecule per unit time.

SelectivityResults.title: SelectivityResults
SelectivityResults.description: Selectivity measurements including stereoselectivity, enantioselectivity, and other selectivity parameters.

chemoselectivity.title: chemoselectivity
chemoselectivity.description: Description of chemoselectivity when multiple reaction pathways are possible.

diastereomeric_excess.title: diastereomeric_excess
diastereomeric_excess.description: Diastereomeric excess (de) as percentage for reactions producing diastereomers.

enantiomeric_excess.title: enantiomeric_excess
enantiomeric_excess.description: Enantiomeric excess (ee) as percentage indicating optical purity of the product.

enantioselectivity.title: enantioselectivity
enantioselectivity.description: Enantioselectivity ratio (E-value) indicating preference for one enantiomer over another.

isomeric_content.title: isomeric_content
isomeric_content.description: Content or ratio of specific isomers in the product mixture.

regioselectivity.title: regioselectivity
regioselectivity.description: Description of regioselectivity indicating preference for specific reaction sites.

stereoselectivity.title: stereoselectivity
stereoselectivity.description: Qualitative or quantitative description of stereoselectivity in the reaction.

ThermodynamicResults.title: ThermodynamicResults
ThermodynamicResults.description: Thermodynamic parameters characterizing the energetics of the enzymatic reaction.

gibbs_free_energy_change.title: gibbs_free_energy_change
gibbs_free_energy_change.description: Gibbs free energy change (ΔG) for the reaction.

YieldAndConversionResults.title: YieldAndConversionResults
YieldAndConversionResults.description: Product yield and substrate conversion measurements from enzymatic reactions.

conversion.title: conversion
conversion.description: Substrate conversion as percentage or fraction of initial substrate consumed.

notes.title: notes
notes.description: Additional notes about yield and conversion measurements.

product_yield.title: product_yield
product_yield.description: Product yield as percentage or fraction of theoretical maximum.

space_time_yield.title: space_time_yield
space_time_yield.description: Space-time yield representing product formation rate per unit reactor volume.
